summary: Frontend-only review of the new Operations Modal on /approvals. 4 of 5 features PASS end-to-end. F3 (Department-mandatory toast) cannot be fully exercised without selecting a task Type first because the Type check fires before Department check — code path is correct (line 279 of OurTasksPage.js) but test was limited; recommend main agent verify by quick manual test (fill Name + Type, leave Department empty). Minor F4 observation: in Projects 'Edit' mode the delete (Trash2) icon buttons appear (11 found) but no pencil (Edit2) icon buttons were found via .lucide-pencil — needs confirmation that an edit-row affordance exists for projects.

integration_issues.flow: Assign to Team — Department mandatory toast (FEATURE 3)
integration_issues.issue: Validation order: handleCreateTask() checks Type before Department, so if Type is also empty the user sees 'Please pick a Type for this task' instead of 'Please select a Department before creating a team task'. Logic is correct when Type is filled; this is just a test coverage gap. Optionally swap the validation order so Department fires first inside Assign-to-Team tab for a clearer UX.

integration_issues.flow: Projects Edit mode — Pencil/edit icon visibility (FEATURE 4)
integration_issues.issue: Delete (Trash2) icons rendered (11 found on project rows) but no Pencil/Edit2 icon buttons detected via .lucide-pencil selectors. Either ProjectsPanel uses a different edit affordance (e.g., row click / kebab menu / different lucide name like SquarePen) or the per-row Edit button is missing. Please confirm intended edit UX on project rows in Edit mode.

action_items: Verify Feature 3 manually: in Assign-to-Team tab, fill Task Name + select a Type, leave Department empty, click Create — expect toast 'Please select a Department before creating a team task'. Code path exists (OurTasksPage.js line 279) but testing agent could not auto-select Type via Radix select in time.

Confirm Feature 4 edit-row affordance in Projects panel — only Trash2 icons were detected, no Pencil. If pencil icons exist, they may use a different lucide class name; otherwise add per-row Edit button visible only in 'edit' mode.
(Optional) Reorder validations in handleCreateTask so Department check (assign_to_team) fires before Type check, for clearer error messaging.
critical_code_review_comments: OurTasksPage.js is very large (>1500 lines) — recommend extracting tabs (My Tasks, Assign to Team, Approvals, Projects, Departments, Meetings) into dedicated child components per code-review guideline (>700 LOC threshold).

OperationsModalPage useEffect for Escape uses empty dep array but references handleClose — currently fine because handleClose is stable closure, but adding it to deps (or wrapping in useCallback) is safer.

ApprovalsPage decisionTask modal renders X button using template-literal-inside-string 'border-b ${borderColor}' which is NOT interpolated (it's wrapped in plain quotes around the JSX className concat). See line ~638: className="p-6 border-b ${borderColor}" — the ${borderColor} is a literal string, not interpolated. Border color will be wrong/missing on the decision modal header.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (F1/F2/F4/F5 pass, F3 partial — code correct, test gap)

Login confirmed working with Admin@123 (NOT admin123 as iteration_65 listed).

rca_of_the_issue.feature3_partial: handleCreateTask runs validations in order: (1) task_name empty → toast; (2) type empty → toast 'Please pick a Type'; (3) recurrence-needs-date; (4) mainTab==='assign_to_team' && !department → 'Please select a Department before creating a team task'. So when test left BOTH Type and Department empty, the Type toast fired first. Fix in spec terms: either pre-fill Type in the form by default OR reorder so Department check fires before Type when in Assign-to-Team tab.
rca_of_the_issue.feature4_edit_icon_gap: Selector 'button:has(svg.lucide-pencil)' returned 0 — could be (a) ProjectsPanel does not render per-row edit buttons, only delete + click-row-to-edit, OR (b) icons use a different lucide name like 'square-pen' or 'edit-3'. Main agent should grep ProjectsPanel.js for the edit icon import to confirm.
